description: This file defines the interface ThingBuilder and its nested builder interfaces (FromScratch and FromCopy) for constructing immutable Thing instances using a fluent API with method chaining. It includes methods for setting permissions, attributes, identifiers, features, lifecycle, revision, timestamps, and metadata, often with JSON parsing capabilities and predicates for conditional setting.

classes.name: ThingBuilder
classes.description: Main interface for building Thing instances, with nested builder interfaces for creating new Things (FromScratch) or copying existing ones (FromCopy).

methods.name: generateRandomThingId
methods.description: Generates a random Thing ID without namespace. Deprecated in favor of typed ID.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Sets the given revision to this builder, with overloads for setting by predicate or revision number.

methods.name: setModified
methods.description: Sets the modified timestamp, with predicate support.

methods.name: setCreated
methods.description: Sets the created timestamp, with predicate support.

methods.name: setMetadata
methods.description: Sets the metadata, with predicate support.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the Thing ID, with deprecated and new typed versions, including predicate-based setters.

methods.name: setGeneratedId
methods.description: Sets a generated ID, with predicate support.
